title: Theorem
body_md:
A 2-category with contravariance has opposites, as in
  \ref*{label@name@defn:opposite}~\ref{defn:opposite}, exactly if when regarded as a \bV-category it
  has all copowers by $\ensuremath{\mathbbb{1}}\xspace^{-}$.{
